title: Novel inhibitors of oncogenic Wnt/TCF-4/beta-catenin signaling pathway: Design, synthesis, molecular docking studies and apoptosis inducing activity of pyrimidothiazino-, dihydropyrimidotriazepino- and 1,3,4-thiadiazolopyrimido-indole hybrids.
authors: Mourad, Mai A E; Mourad, Ahmed A E; Elmaaty, Ayman Abo; Hofni, Amal; Khodir, Ahmed E; Aboubakr, Esam M; Eldehna, Wagdy M; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成Wnt/TCF-4/β-catenin通路抑制剂，虽涉及TCF-4蛋白-DNA互作靶点并含分子对接，但核心为小分子药物设计与细胞实验，非TF-DNA结合机制建模研究。
abstract: Wnt pathway is vital for survival of cancer-initiating cells. beta-catenin plays a crucial role in Wnt pathway through interaction with TCF-4 to transcribe oncogenes. beta-catenin activation suppresses immune cell infiltration into cancer cells and promotes resistance to chemotherapeutic drugs. In order to target Wnt/TCF-4/beta-catenin pathway, a novel series of pyrimidothiazino-, dihydropyrimidotriazepino- and 1,3,4 thiadiazolopyrimido-indole hybrids were designed, synthesized and evaluated for their beta-catenin/TCF-4 inhibitory and apoptotic inducing activities. Cytotoxicity of the synthesized hybrids was evaluated against HCT-116, A549 and HepG2 cell lines. Of the synthesized hybrids, 6a, 8b and 12b hybrids elicited superior cytotoxic activity compared to quercetin against the tested cell lines. These hybrids were able to significantly suppress beta-catenin and its down-stream signaling target TCF-4 in a dose-dependent manner in HCT-116 cell line. They up-regulated p53, caspase-3, caspase-8, caspase-9 levels and Bax protein expression as well as down-regulated Bcl-2 protein expression. They successfully arrested cell cycle in pre-G1 phase and G0/G1 phase. The synthesized hybrids achieved efficient binding pattern in molecular docking study and have acceptable drug likeness characters.
abstract_zh: Wnt通路对于癌症起始细胞的存活至关重要。β-catenin通过与TCF-4相互作用在Wnt通路中发挥关键作用，从而转录致癌基因。β-catenin的激活抑制免疫细胞浸润至癌细胞，并促进对化疗药物的耐药性。为了靶向Wnt/TCF-4/β-catenin通路，设计、合成了一系列新型的嘧啶并噻嗪-、二氢嘧啶并三氮卓-和1,3,4噻二唑并嘧啶-吲哚杂合体，并评估了它们的β-catenin/TCF-4抑制活性和凋亡诱导活性。合成的杂合体对HCT-116、A549和HepG2细胞系的细胞毒性进行了评估。在合成的杂合体中，6a、8b和12b杂合体对测试细胞系表现出优于槲皮素的细胞毒性活性。这些杂合体在HCT-116细胞系中能够以剂量依赖性方式显著抑制β-catenin及其下游信号靶点TCF-4。它们上调了p53、caspase-3、caspase-8、caspase-9水平和Bax蛋白表达，同时下调了Bcl-2蛋白表达。它们成功地将细胞周期阻滞在pre-G1期和G0/G1期。合成的杂合体在分子对接研究中实现了有效的结合模式，并具有可接受的药物相似性特征。
